name: Epipolar Slice Distribution
definition: A strategy for distributing epipolar slices non-uniformly along the image perimeter to guarantee proper sampling density (no screen pixel further than half a pixel from an epipolar line) while minimizing the total number of slices.
summary: Epipolar Slice Distribution is a non-uniform sampling strategy that guarantees a strict half-pixel sampling error bound without upsampling, minimizing slice count while maintaining accuracy.
